name_zh: 纳比赫·贝里/黎巴嫩共识制：教派协商制与权力分享
name_en: Nabih Berri/Lebanese Consensus: Confessional Consultation & Power-Sharing
description_zh: 纳比赫·贝里 (1938-) 1992- 任黎巴嫩议长，阿迈勒运动领袖，什叶派核心人物。黎巴嫩"教派协商制" (Confessionalism) 核心架构：1943 年国民契约(马龙派总统/逊尼总理/什叶议长/正教副总统/德鲁兹参谋长) -> 1989 年塔伊夫协议(权力下放/什叶提权/叙利亚保证人) -> 2005 叙军撤出/2008 多哈协议(否决权/团结政府)。贝里作为什叶"门神"，长期主持议会协商、调解教派冲突、平衡亲西方/亲伊朗轴心。体现 M149 伊斯兰咨询制/教派协商——以配额制/否决权/共识门槛替代多数决，在深度分裂社会中实现精英层面的冲突管理。
description_en: Nabih Berri (1938-) Speaker since 1992, Amal Movement leader, Shia core figure. Lebanon's 'Confessionalism' core architecture: 1943 National Pact (Maronite President/Sunni PM/Shia Speaker/Orthodox VP/Druze Chief of Staff) -> 1989 Taif Agreement (devolution/Shia empowerment/Syria guarantor) -> 2005 Syrian withdrawal/2008 Doha Agreement (veto/unity gov). Berri as Shia 'gatekeeper' long presides parliamentary consultation, mediates sectarian conflicts, balances pro-West/pro-Iran axes. Exemplifies M149 Islamic Shura/Consultation & Confessional Power-Sharing - quota/veto/consensus thresholds replace majority rule, achieving elite-level conflict management in deeply divided society.
reason_zh: 黎巴嫩非民主制而是"教派协商制"：18 个教派按人口比例分配权力，决策需跨教派共识。贝里 30 年议长生涯展示 M149 在实战中的运作——配额制防多数暴政、否决权保少数利益、共识门槛迫使妥协。区隔于 M146 乌班图(非洲)、M172 少数派生存(叙利亚)，核心在于"制度化教派配额+精英协商+外部保证人"的脆弱平衡。
reason_en: Lebanon not democracy but 'confessional consultation': 18 sects allocated power by demographic quota, decisions require cross-sectarian consensus. Berri's 30-year speakership demonstrates M149 in action - quota prevents majority tyranny, veto protects minority interests, consensus threshold forces compromise. Distinct from M146 Ubuntu (Africa) and M172 Minority Survival (Syria), core: 'institutionalized sectarian quota + elite consultation + external guarantor' fragile equilibrium.
steps_zh: 国民契约配额锚定：1943/1989/2008 三版配额，什叶从边缘走向核心(议长/财长/卫生部)
议会协商程序化：贝里主持《议事规则》，法案需两大阵营(3月14日/3月8日)共识才能通过
否决权实战运用：什叶部长集体辞职/议会抵制/街头动员，迫使对手让步(2006/2008/2019)
外部保证人平衡：叙利亚(1990-2005)/伊朗(真主党)/沙特/法国/美国轮番施压，贝里周旋其间
危机生存与代价：内战(1975-90)/政治真空(2014-16/2022-)/金融崩溃(2019-)，共识制维持国家不崩解但治理瘫痪
steps_en: National Pact quota anchoring: 1943/1989/2008 three quota versions, Shia from margin to core (Speaker/Finance/Health)
Parliamentary consultation proceduralized: Berri presides 'Rules of Procedure', bills need both camps (March 14/March 8) consensus to pass
Veto power tactical deployment: Shia ministers mass resign/parliament boycott/street mobilization, forcing concessions (2006/2008/2019)
External guarantor balancing: Syria (1990-05)/Iran(Hezbollah)/Saudi/France/US rotate pressure, Berri navigates between
Crisis survival & cost: civil war (1975-90)/political vacuum (2014-16/2022-)/financial collapse (2019-), consensus keeps state from collapse but governance paralyzed
expected_zh: 深度分裂社会以"制度化配额+精英协商+否决权"三支柱避免内战复燃，但治理效能极低，为多教派社会提供"生存优于治理"的反面范式。
expected_en: Deeply divided society avoids civil war relapse via trinity of 'institutionalized quota + elite consultation + veto power', but governance effectiveness near zero, providing 'survival over governance' cautionary paradigm for multi-sectarian societies.
case_zh: 1992-2024 连任 8 届议长；2006 真主党战争/2008 多哈协议/2019 金融崩溃/2022 真空 13 个月，议会 4 年 0 法案通过常态化，国家机能靠外部援助维持。
case_en: 1992-2024 re-elected 8 terms Speaker; 2006 Hezbollah war/2008 Doha/2019 financial collapse/2022 13-month vacuum, parliament 4 years 0 bills passed normalized, state functions sustained by foreign aid.
cross_cultural_impact: Confessionalism model for Iraq/Bosnia/Cyprus; Shia political empowerment; consensus democracy theory
spiritual_tradition: Shia Islam (Amal/Hezbollah) / Maronite Catholic / Sunni / Druze / Orthodox
colonial_history: French Mandate 1920-1943; Ottoman Mount Lebanon autonomy
resource_curse_mitigation: No oil; banking secrecy (pre-2019); remittance dependency; port explosion 2020
